openSources.title: Open sources
openSources.placeholder: A verse, a law, a poem or a statistic
openSources.hint: Type to search the sources on this device; “Search online” asks before it sends anything.
openSources.noLocal: Nothing on this device. Try “Search online”.
openSources.confirm: Search online for “{query}”? Only these words go to the sources you turned on (the Knesset, data.gov.il), nothing from your notes.
openSources.confirmFetch: Fetch “{what}” from its source? Only its reference or id is sent.
openSources.switches: Sources (off: nothing is sent to it)
openSources.keys: ↑↓ choose · Enter insert · Alt+O search online · Esc close
openSources.sends.datagov: sends search words and dataset ids
